label: Application and Discord Bot Hosting
tagline: One plan, any language, always on. Discord bots, APIs and workers.
description: Run Node.js, Python, Go, Bun, Deno, Elixir, Rust, Java, C# or Dart on the same server and switch runtime from the Startup tab in the panel. Your files, port and limits stay put when you switch. NVMe storage, DDoS protection, and a panel that works from your phone.
highlights: Pick the language from a dropdown, change it any time
Built for Discord bots, REST APIs and background workers
NVMe storage with DDoS protection on every plan
